title: Steins;Gate: The Thing in the Roof
alt: A view up at the top storeys of a pale city building under a bleached blue summer sky with tall white clouds. A great round machine of grey metal, in steps, with a small dome on top and two flat panels at an angle beside it, is driven into the edge of the roof. It stands in the top storey: the edge of the roof is broken away round it, and the room behind is dark. Short cracks run down the wall under the break, and two windows there have lost their glass. Under the roof is a band of bright painted boards; below are rows of dark windows, and at the left hangs a tall yellow sign with red squares. Pale rooftops stand low at the right.
summary: A painting of the machine in the roof of the Radio Kaikan building from Steins;Gate in {strokes} brush strokes, with a playback of each stroke.
text: This is the start of Steins;Gate, a visual novel by 5pb. and Nitroplus. On a hot day in July, a round machine is found in the roof of the Radio Kaikan building in Akihabara. The news calls it a satellite. No one saw it fall.
It is a time machine. The story is about small changes to the past and what they cost. No one is in the picture. The painting has {strokes} brush strokes.
